correctness.rationale: Independent Cartesian-ancestor and local-maximum representations give exact indicator probabilities. The complete conditional boundary-correction table is derived by integrating truncated uniform priorities, and rational telescoping proves the finite covariance formulas. A positive cubic derivative and strictly negative rational G establish signs in all ranks; direct enumeration through n=8 and formula scans to n=120 passed 423989 exact assertions. Proof is for arbitrary integer n, not inferred from finite checks.

value.rationale: This is a complete, infinite-order, sign-reversing dependence classification for individual BST key-search cost versus total internal leaves, two natural but distinct complexity/shape variables. Explicit covariances show different limiting endpoint, near-endpoint and bulk effects; it is neither a marginal textbook identity nor an unmotivated finite slice.
